reader.requirement: At --std 85 a symbolic-character (bare or with the redundant ALL) defined in SPECIAL-NAMES SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS stands for one or more of the character at ordinal integer-1 of the native set (or of alphabet-name-2 under IN, §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR8), repeated to the associated item's size in VALUE/MOVE/compare and one character where no item is associated; a word not so defined is not a figurative constant.

edition-consulted.switches: the FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL phrase of SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS (Constructs.SpecialNamesForNational2002): COBOL0900 at 85, admitted at 2002+; the base clause is edition-invariant

reader.edition-search: SwitchBindSymbolic uses Edition.At/Edition.Error only for position and reporting (no edition comparison); grepped -i symbolic in VersionConformancePass.cs, LiteralEnvironment.cs and ExpressionBinder.cs; the ordinal-to-character resolution (CollatingTable.Repertoire / inSet.CharAt) and the BoundAllLiteral fill are shared by every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the value; yes for the clause syntax: 85 refuses the 2002 FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL phrase
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers VALUE SYM and VALUE ALL SYM on PIC X; not exercised: MOVE/compare sizing on X(n), JUSTIFIED and group receivers, DISPLAY/STRING one-character length, INSPECT operands, the IN alphabet-name phrase, multiple names per clause, and the clause refusals

probes.printed: A=[AAA] B=[BBBB] C=[AAAA] D=[BBBB][BBBB] E=[AB"] F=Y G=Y H=[RRR] I=[AB ] J=[a"b"c] K=02 L=["""]
probes.expected: SYM-A (66)='A' fills X(3); ALL SYM-B fills JUSTIFIED X(4); group of 4 filled; VALUE bare and ALL both fill X(4); DISPLAY one char each; compare equal; SYM-R IS 2 IN AB ('QRS') = 'R'; STRING one char each; INSPECT BY/FOR one char; ordinal 35 = '"'; a PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE does not change the native ordinal

COBOL1639: the VALUE operand 'SYM-Z' is not a literal
probes.expected: an undefined word is not a symbolic-character: refused

probes.printed: COBOL0900: the FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL phrase ... requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)

probes.expected: an ordinal within the implementor's native set (65536) is accepted and gives that character

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 GR7  (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values)  the text is in GR7
OK  §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR8  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8

reader.notes: SwitchBindSymbolic resolves each name to the character at integer-1 (native, or the IN alphabet's CharAt), and ExpressionBinder.SymbolicOperand turns every use into a one-character BoundAllLiteral, so the GRL2.1/L2.2 sizing is the ALL-literal sizing. Every context probed sizes and values correctly at 85; the only edition switch on the path is the 2002 FOR phrase gate, which 85 correctly refuses. Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 clause numbers (wording only).

refuter.evidence: cite.py: OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 GR7 'specified as the value of this symbolic-character'. Read §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR4d (ALSO: only literal-1 represents the character; unspecified characters follow in native order) and GR8. E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-005/sa.cob at --std 85: SYMBOLIC IN an ALPHABET with ALSO (ordinal 1='Q'), descending THRU ("Z" THRU "X", ordinal 2='Y'), ordinals past the listed literals (4 = LOW-VALUE, 69='A', 85='T' = native order skipping Q,R,S), IN STANDARD-1 (66='A'), UNSTRING DELIMITED BY a symbolic-character, and a contained program using the containing program's symbolic-characters (§1985 Configuration Section applies to contained programs) printed A=[QRS] B=Y C=[ATYA] D=[ab ][cde] E=[QQQ][YYY], all as the text gives. Refusals: E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-005/sb.cob symbolic-character in CLASS -> COBOL1671, E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-005/sd.cob in ALPHABET -> COBOL1906 (§1985 SPECIAL-NAMES SR5) and ADD SQ -> COBOL0844, E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-005/sc.cob CONFIGURATION SECTION in a contained program -> COBOL1643. Side observation outside this rule: IF SA4 = LOW-VALUE (two literals) compiles at 85 with warning COBOL3146, but §1985:VI.6.3.1.1 'must contain at least one reference to a variable' (cite.py OK) makes it a syntax violation: a possible under-reject for the relation-condition rule's own case.
